as_told.title: 1992 CE-5 group near Pensacola sees four craft

plain: In the early 1990s, four alien craft are said to have suddenly appeared in the air near Pensacola, Florida, in front of a group of about 60 people spending a weekend on a beach. A UFO researcher named Steven Greer says he was there and that the group was "demonstrating" contact when the craft "just pop up right into right there"; in one telling he puts it in 1992. He says that afterward all kinds of people began coming to him, and that others knew about the event, which would mean such contact can be called up on purpose.
